args: root=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}; candidates=(); if [[ -n "$root" && "${root:h:t}" == pinland-for-codex ]]; then candidates=("${root:h}"/*(N/om)); elif [[ ! -x "$root/scripts/launch-pinland-mcp" ]]; then codex_home=${CODEX_HOME:-${HOME:-}/.codex}; candidates=("$codex_home"/plugins/cache/*/pinland-for-codex/*(N/om)); fi; for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do if [[ -x "$candidate/scripts/launch-pinland-mcp" && -f "$candidate/mcp/pins-sync-server.mjs" ]]; then root=$candidate; break; fi; done; [[ -x "$root/scripts/launch-pinland-mcp" && -f "$root/mcp/pins-sync-server.mjs" ]] || exit 127; PLUGIN_ROOT="$root" exec "$root/scripts/launch-pinland-mcp" "$root/mcp/pins-sync-server.mjs"
